I'll write a general-purpose `post-checkout` hook that discovers asset directories using common conventions (directories named `assets`, `static`, `public`, `images`, `fonts`, `icons`, `media`, etc.) and also looks for git-tracked binary/asset files to infer their parent dirs.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# .git/hooks/post-checkout
#
# Identifies all asset directories in the repository after a checkout.
#
# Arguments passed by git:
#   $1 - previous HEAD ref (before checkout)
#   $2 - new HEAD ref (after checkout)
#   $3 - checkout type: 1 = branch checkout, 0 = file checkout
#
# Usage: copy or symlink this file to .git/hooks/post-checkout
#        and make it executable: chmod +x .git/hooks/post-checkout

set -euo pipefail

PREV_HEAD="$1"
NEW_HEAD="$2"
CHECKOUT_TYPE="$3"  # 1 = branch/commit, 0 = file

# Only run on branch/commit checkouts, not individual file restores
if [[ "$CHECKOUT_TYPE" != "1" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Directory names considered "asset directories" by convention
ASSET_DIR_NAMES=(
  assets
  static
  public
  media
  images
  imgs
  icons
  fonts
  videos
  audio
  sounds
  svg
  sprites
  textures
  i18n
  locale
  locales
  dist
  build
  out
)

# File extensions treated as asset/binary files
# Used to infer asset directories from git-tracked files
ASSET_EXTENSIONS=(
  png jpg jpeg gif webp avif svg ico bmp tiff
  mp4 webm mov avi mkv ogv
  mp3 wav ogg flac aac m4a
  woff woff2 ttf otf eot
  pdf
  zip tar gz
  glb gltf obj fbx
  psd ai sketch fig
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

declare -A FOUND_DIRS  # associative array used as a set

# Add a directory to the found set (normalised, relative to repo root)
add_dir() {
  local dir
  dir="$(realpath --relative-to="$REPO_ROOT" "$1" 2>/dev/null || echo "$1")"
  # Skip .git internals
  [[ "$dir" == .git* ]] && return
  FOUND_DIRS["$dir"]=1
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Strategy 1: directory names matching known asset conventions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_by_name() {
  local pattern
  # Build a single -name expression: -name "assets" -o -name "static" ...
  local find_args=()
  for name in "${ASSET_DIR_NAMES[@]}"; do
    find_args+=( -o -name "$name" )
  done
  # Remove leading "-o"
  unset 'find_args[0]'

  while IFS= read -r -d '' dir; do
    add_dir "$dir"
  done < <(find "$REPO_ROOT" \
    \( -path "$REPO_ROOT/.git" -prune \) \
    -o -type d \( "${find_args[@]}" \) -print0 2>/dev/null)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Strategy 2: git-tracked files whose extension marks them as assets
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_by_tracked_extensions() {
  local ext_pattern
  # Build a grep pattern: \.(png|jpg|jpeg|...)$
  local joined
  joined="$(IFS='|'; echo "${ASSET_EXTENSIONS[*]}")"
  ext_pattern="\.(${joined})$"

  while IFS= read -r file; do
    local dir
    dir="$(dirname "$file")"
    [[ "$dir" == "." ]] && continue
    add_dir "$REPO_ROOT/$dir"
  done < <(git ls-files | grep -Ei "$ext_pattern" 2>/dev/null || true)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Strategy 3: .gitattributes — directories containing files marked binary
#             or with LFS filters
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_by_gitattributes() {
  [[ ! -f "$REPO_ROOT/.gitattributes" ]] && return

  while IFS= read -r file; do
    local dir
    dir="$(dirname "$file")"
    [[ "$dir" == "." ]] && continue
    add_dir "$REPO_ROOT/$dir"
  done < <(
    # Find git-tracked files that match LFS or binary attribute patterns
    git ls-files | while IFS= read -r f; do
      attr="$(git check-attr filter diff merge -- "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
      if echo "$attr" | grep -qE '(filter: lfs|diff: unset|-diff)'; then
        echo "$f"
      fi
    done
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Strategy 4: package.json / webpack / vite / parcel config hints
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_by_config_hints() {
  # Common config files that reference asset/static dirs
  local configs=(
    webpack.config.js webpack.config.ts
    vite.config.js vite.config.ts
    rollup.config.js rollup.config.ts
    parcel.config.json .parcelrc
    next.config.js next.config.ts
    nuxt.config.js nuxt.config.ts
    svelte.config.js
    angular.json
    astro.config.mjs astro.config.ts
  )

  for cfg in "${configs[@]}"; do
    [[ ! -f "$REPO_ROOT/$cfg" ]] && continue
    # Extract quoted directory-like values (e.g. "public", "./assets", "../static")
    while IFS= read -r candidate; do
      # Strip quotes and leading ./
      candidate="${candidate//\"/}"
      candidate="${candidate//\'/}"
      candidate="${candidate#./}"
      candidate="${candidate#/}"
      [[ -z "$candidate" ]] && continue
      local full="$REPO_ROOT/$candidate"
      [[ -d "$full" ]] && add_dir "$full"
    done < <(grep -Eo '"[./]?[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+(\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)*"' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null \
      | grep -Ei '(asset|static|public|media|image|font|icon|dist|build|out|resource)' \
      || true)
  done
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Run all strategies
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_by_name
find_by_tracked_extensions
find_by_gitattributes
find_by_config_hints

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Report
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ ${#FOUND_DIRS[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "[post-checkout] No asset directories identified."
  exit 0
fi

echo "[post-checkout] Asset directories identified (${#FOUND_DIRS[@]}):"
# Sort for stable output
sorted=()
while IFS= read -r -d '' key; do
  sorted+=("$key")
done < <(printf '%s\0' "${!FOUND_DIRS[@]}" | sort -z)

for dir in "${sorted[@]}"; do
  echo "  → $dir"
done

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: write the list to a file for downstream tooling
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ASSET_LIST_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/.git/asset-dirs.txt"
printf '%s\n' "${sorted[@]}" > "$ASSET_LIST_FILE"
echo "[post-checkout] List written to: .git/asset-dirs.txt"

Here's what the script does and how to use it.

---

## `post-checkout` hook — Asset Directory Identifier

### Install
```bash
cp post-checkout .git/hooks/post-checkout
chmod +x .git/hooks/post-checkout
```

Or symlink it if you keep hooks in the repo:
```bash
ln -s ../../hooks/post-checkout .git/hooks/post-checkout
```

---

### How it works

It runs **four complementary strategies** and deduplicates the results:

| Strategy | What it looks for |
|---|---|
| **1 — Name conventions** | Directories named `assets`, `static`, `public`, `images`, `fonts`, `media`, `dist`, `build`, etc. |
| **2 — Tracked extensions** | Files committed to git with asset extensions (`.png`, `.woff2`, `.mp4`, `.svg`, …) — their parent dirs are asset dirs |
| **3 — `.gitattributes`** | Files tagged with `filter=lfs` or `-diff` (binary) — same parent-dir logic |
| **4 — Config file hints** | Parses `vite.config.*`, `webpack.config.*`, `next.config.*`, `angular.json`, etc. for quoted paths containing asset-related keywords |

---

### Output

On every branch/commit checkout it prints:
```
[post-checkout] Asset directories identified (3):
  → public
  → src/assets
  → src/fonts
[post-checkout] List written to: .git/asset-dirs.txt
```

It also writes `.git/asset-dirs.txt` — a stable newline-delimited list downstream tools (CI scripts, Makefile targets, LFS pull scripts) can read without re-running the hook.

---

### Notes
- **Skips file-level checkouts** (`git checkout -- file`) — only fires on branch/commit switches.
- All paths are relative to the repo root for portability.
- `.git` internals are always excluded.
- Easy to extend: add more names to `ASSET_DIR_NAMES` or extensions to `ASSET_EXTENSIONS` at the top of the script.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# asset-rebuild
#
# Recursively deletes large binary assets across all identified asset
# directories, then recreates them from source templates.
#
# USAGE
#   asset-rebuild [OPTIONS] [TARGET_DIR ...]
#
# OPTIONS
#   -t, --template-dir DIR   Directory containing source templates and the
#                            asset manifest. Default: .asset-templates/
#   -m, --manifest FILE      Path to the asset manifest (JSON). Default:
#                            <template-dir>/manifest.json
#   -s, --size-threshold N   Only delete files >= N bytes. Default: 102400 (100 KB)
#   -e, --extension EXT      Extra binary extension to target (repeatable).
#   -n, --dry-run            Show what would happen without changing anything.
#   -f, --force              Skip the confirmation prompt.
#   -v, --verbose            Print every file processed.
#   -h, --help               Show this help text.
#
# TARGET_DIR
#   One or more asset directories to operate on. If omitted, directories are
#   auto-discovered (from .git/asset-dirs.txt if present, otherwise via a
#   live scan identical to the post-checkout hook).
#
# MANIFEST FORMAT  (.asset-templates/manifest.json)
#   A JSON array of template entries:
#
#   [
#     {
#       "template": "placeholder-image.png",   // file inside template-dir
#       "targets": [                            // repo-relative output paths
#         "public/images/hero.png",
#         "public/images/logo.png"
#       ],
#       "generator": "scripts/gen-image.sh",   // optional: run instead of copy
#       "generator_args": ["--width=1920"]      // extra args passed to generator
#     },
#     {
#       "template": "blank.woff2",
#       "targets": ["assets/fonts/custom.woff2"]
#     }
#   ]
#
#   If "generator" is set the script is called as:
#     <generator> <template_path> <target_path> [generator_args...]
#   and is expected to produce the target file itself.
#   If "generator" is absent the template is simply copied to each target.
#
# TEMPLATE DIRECTORY LAYOUT
#   .asset-templates/
#   ├── manifest.json
#   ├── placeholder-image.png
#   ├── blank.woff2
#   └── scripts/
#       └── gen-image.sh
#
# EXIT CODES
#   0  Success
#   1  Usage / argument error
#   2  Missing required file (manifest, template)
#   3  Generator script failed
#   4  Aborted by user

set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Defaults
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
TEMPLATE_DIR=".asset-templates"
MANIFEST_FILE=""            # resolved after TEMPLATE_DIR is known
SIZE_THRESHOLD=102400       # 100 KB
DRY_RUN=false
FORCE=false
VERBOSE=false
EXTRA_EXTENSIONS=()
TARGET_DIRS=()

# Binary extensions — kept in sync with post-checkout hook
ASSET_EXTENSIONS=(
  png jpg jpeg gif webp avif svg ico bmp tiff
  mp4 webm mov avi mkv ogv
  mp3 wav ogg flac aac m4a
  woff woff2 ttf otf eot
  pdf
  zip tar gz
  glb gltf obj fbx
  psd ai sketch fig
)

ASSET_DIR_NAMES=(
  assets static public media images imgs icons fonts
  videos audio sounds svg sprites textures
  i18n locale locales dist build out
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Logging helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
RED='\033[0;31m'; YELLOW='\033[1;33m'; GREEN='\033[0;32m'
CYAN='\033[0;36m'; BOLD='\033[1m'; RESET='\033[0m'

info()    { echo -e "${CYAN}[asset-rebuild]${RESET} $*"; }
success() { echo -e "${GREEN}[asset-rebuild]${RESET} $*"; }
warn()    { echo -e "${YELLOW}[asset-rebuild] WARN:${RESET} $*" >&2; }
error()   { echo -e "${RED}[asset-rebuild] ERROR:${RESET} $*" >&2; }
verbose() { $VERBOSE && echo -e "  ${BOLD}↳${RESET} $*" || true; }
die()     { error "$*"; exit 1; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Usage
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
usage() {
  sed -n '/^# USAGE/,/^# EXIT CODES/{ /^# EXIT CODES/d; s/^# \{0,1\}//; p }' "$0"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Argument parsing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
parse_args() {
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      -t|--template-dir)   TEMPLATE_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      -m|--manifest)       MANIFEST_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      -s|--size-threshold) SIZE_THRESHOLD="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      -e|--extension)      EXTRA_EXTENSIONS+=("$2"); shift 2 ;;
      -n|--dry-run)        DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
      -f|--force)          FORCE=true; shift ;;
      -v|--verbose)        VERBOSE=true; shift ;;
      -h|--help)           usage; exit 0 ;;
      --) shift; TARGET_DIRS+=("$@"); break ;;
      -*) die "Unknown option: $1  (try --help)" ;;
      *)  TARGET_DIRS+=("$1"); shift ;;
    esac
  done

  # Merge extra extensions
  ASSET_EXTENSIONS+=("${EXTRA_EXTENSIONS[@]}")

  # Resolve manifest path
  [[ -z "$MANIFEST_FILE" ]] && MANIFEST_FILE="$TEMPLATE_DIR/manifest.json"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Resolve repo root (works inside or outside a git repo)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resolve_repo_root() {
  if git rev-parse --show-toplevel &>/dev/null 2>&1; then
    git rev-parse --show-toplevel
  else
    pwd
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Asset-directory discovery (mirrors post-checkout hook logic)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
discover_asset_dirs() {
  local repo_root="$1"
  local -n _out_dirs="$2"   # nameref to caller's array

  # Prefer the pre-built list from the post-checkout hook
  local cached="$repo_root/.git/asset-dirs.txt"
  if [[ -f "$cached" ]]; then
    info "Using cached asset directory list from .git/asset-dirs.txt"
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      [[ -n "$line" && -d "$repo_root/$line" ]] && _out_dirs+=("$repo_root/$line")
    done < "$cached"
    return
  fi

  info "No cached list found — running live asset directory scan..."

  declare -A _seen

  # Strategy 1: directory names
  local find_args=()
  for name in "${ASSET_DIR_NAMES[@]}"; do
    find_args+=( -o -name "$name" )
  done
  unset 'find_args[0]'

  while IFS= read -r -d '' dir; do
    [[ "$dir" == "$repo_root/.git"* ]] && continue
    local rel
    rel="$(realpath --relative-to="$repo_root" "$dir" 2>/dev/null || echo "$dir")"
    [[ -z "${_seen[$rel]+_}" ]] && { _seen[$rel]=1; _out_dirs+=("$dir"); }
  done < <(find "$repo_root" \
    \( -path "$repo_root/.git" -prune \) \
    -o -type d \( "${find_args[@]}" \) -print0 2>/dev/null)

  # Strategy 2: tracked file extensions
  if git -C "$repo_root" rev-parse HEAD &>/dev/null 2>&1; then
    local joined; joined="$(IFS='|'; echo "${ASSET_EXTENSIONS[*]}")"
    local ext_pat="\.(${joined})$"
    while IFS= read -r file; do
      local dir; dir="$repo_root/$(dirname "$file")"
      [[ "$(dirname "$file")" == "." ]] && continue
      local rel; rel="$(realpath --relative-to="$repo_root" "$dir" 2>/dev/null || echo "$dir")"
      [[ -z "${_seen[$rel]+_}" ]] && { _seen[$rel]=1; _out_dirs+=("$dir"); }
    done < <(git -C "$repo_root" ls-files 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei "$ext_pat" || true)
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the extension grep pattern
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ext_pattern() {
  local joined; joined="$(IFS='|'; echo "${ASSET_EXTENSIONS[*]}")"
  echo "\.(${joined})$"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PHASE 1 — Find and delete large binary assets
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
phase_delete() {
  local -n _dirs="$1"
  local pattern; pattern="$(ext_pattern)"
  local deleted=0
  local skipped=0

  info "Phase 1: scanning for large binary assets (>= $(numfmt --to=iec "$SIZE_THRESHOLD" 2>/dev/null || echo "${SIZE_THRESHOLD} bytes"))..."

  for dir in "${_dirs[@]}"; do
    [[ ! -d "$dir" ]] && { warn "Directory not found, skipping: $dir"; continue; }

    while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
      local size
      size="$(stat -c%s "$file" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"

      if (( size >= SIZE_THRESHOLD )); then
        local rel_file; rel_file="$(realpath --relative-to="$REPO_ROOT" "$file")"
        local human_size; human_size="$(numfmt --to=iec "$size" 2>/dev/null || echo "${size}B")"
        verbose "DELETE  $rel_file  ($human_size)"

        if ! $DRY_RUN; then
          rm -f "$file"
        fi
        (( deleted++ )) || true
      else
        (( skipped++ )) || true
      fi
    done < <(find "$dir" -type f -print0 2>/dev/null \
      | grep -zEi "$pattern" || true)
  done

  if $DRY_RUN; then
    info "  [dry-run] Would delete $deleted file(s) ($skipped below threshold, kept)."
  else
    success "  Deleted $deleted large binary asset(s). ($skipped below threshold, kept)"
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dependency check: jq is required for manifest parsing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
require_jq() {
  if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
    die "jq is required for manifest parsing. Install it: https://stedolan.github.io/jq/"
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PHASE 2 — Recreate assets from source templates
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
phase_recreate() {
  [[ ! -f "$MANIFEST_FILE" ]] && {
    warn "No manifest found at '$MANIFEST_FILE' — skipping recreation phase."
    warn "Create $MANIFEST_FILE to define templates. See --help for the format."
    return 0
  }

  require_jq

  local entry_count; entry_count="$(jq 'length' "$MANIFEST_FILE")"
  info "Phase 2: recreating assets from $entry_count template entry/entries in $MANIFEST_FILE..."

  local created=0
  local failed=0

  for i in $(seq 0 $(( entry_count - 1 ))); do
    local template target_json generator generator_args_json

    template="$(jq -r ".[$i].template" "$MANIFEST_FILE")"
    target_json="$(jq -c ".[$i].targets" "$MANIFEST_FILE")"
    generator="$(jq -r ".[$i].generator // empty" "$MANIFEST_FILE")"
    generator_args_json="$(jq -c ".[$i].generator_args // []" "$MANIFEST_FILE")"

    local template_path="$TEMPLATE_DIR/$template"

    if [[ ! -f "$template_path" ]]; then
      error "Template not found: $template_path  (entry $i)"
      (( failed++ )) || true
      continue
    fi

    # Read targets into an array
    local targets=()
    while IFS= read -r t; do
      targets+=("$t")
    done < <(echo "$target_json" | jq -r '.[]')

    # Read generator_args into an array
    local generator_args=()
    while IFS= read -r a; do
      generator_args+=("$a")
    done < <(echo "$generator_args_json" | jq -r '.[]')

    for target in "${targets[@]}"; do
      local target_path="$REPO_ROOT/$target"
      local target_dir; target_dir="$(dirname "$target_path")"
      local rel_target; rel_target="$(realpath --relative-to="$REPO_ROOT" "$target_path" 2>/dev/null || echo "$target")"

      if $DRY_RUN; then
        if [[ -n "$generator" ]]; then
          verbose "GENERATE  $rel_target  via $generator"
        else
          verbose "COPY      $rel_target  ← $template"
        fi
        (( created++ )) || true
        continue
      fi

      # Ensure parent directory exists
      mkdir -p "$target_dir"

      if [[ -n "$generator" ]]; then
        # Run the custom generator
        local gen_path="$REPO_ROOT/$generator"
        if [[ ! -x "$gen_path" ]]; then
          error "Generator not found or not executable: $gen_path  (entry $i)"
          (( failed++ )) || true
          continue
        fi

        verbose "GENERATE  $rel_target  via $generator"
        if ! "$gen_path" "$template_path" "$target_path" "${generator_args[@]}" 2>&1; then
          error "Generator failed for: $rel_target"
          (( failed++ )) || true
          continue
        fi
      else
        # Default: plain copy, preserving timestamps
        verbose "COPY      $rel_target  ← $template"
        cp -p "$template_path" "$target_path"
      fi

      (( created++ )) || true
    done
  done

  if $DRY_RUN; then
    info "  [dry-run] Would recreate $created file(s). ($failed error(s))"
  else
    if (( failed > 0 )); then
      warn "  Recreated $created file(s) with $failed error(s)."
    else
      success "  Recreated $created file(s) successfully."
    fi
  fi

  return $(( failed > 0 ? 3 : 0 ))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Confirmation prompt
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
confirm() {
  local dirs_count="$1"
  echo
  echo -e "${YELLOW}${BOLD}⚠  WARNING: This will permanently delete large binary files.${RESET}"
  echo    "   Asset directories targeted : $dirs_count"
  echo    "   Size threshold             : >= $(numfmt --to=iec "$SIZE_THRESHOLD" 2>/dev/null || echo "${SIZE_THRESHOLD} B")"
  echo    "   Template directory         : $TEMPLATE_DIR"
  echo    "   Manifest                   : $MANIFEST_FILE"
  echo
  echo -n "   Proceed? [y/N] "
  read -r answer
  [[ "$answer" =~ ^[Yy]$ ]] || { info "Aborted."; exit 4; }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarise what directories will be targeted
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
print_target_dirs() {
  local -n _dirs="$1"
  info "Target asset directories (${#_dirs[@]}):"
  for d in "${_dirs[@]}"; do
    echo "    → $(realpath --relative-to="$REPO_ROOT" "$d" 2>/dev/null || echo "$d")"
  done
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
main() {
  parse_args "$@"

  REPO_ROOT="$(resolve_repo_root)"
  cd "$REPO_ROOT"

  # Make TEMPLATE_DIR absolute if relative
  [[ "$TEMPLATE_DIR" != /* ]] && TEMPLATE_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/$TEMPLATE_DIR"
  [[ "$MANIFEST_FILE" != /* ]] && MANIFEST_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/$MANIFEST_FILE"

  # Resolve target directories
  local dirs=()
  if [[ ${#TARGET_DIRS[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    for d in "${TARGET_DIRS[@]}"; do
      [[ "$d" != /* ]] && d="$REPO_ROOT/$d"
      [[ -d "$d" ]] || die "Specified directory does not exist: $d"
      dirs+=("$d")
    done
  else
    discover_asset_dirs "$REPO_ROOT" dirs
  fi

  if [[ ${#dirs[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    warn "No asset directories found. Nothing to do."
    warn "Pass explicit directories as arguments, or create asset directories first."
    exit 0
  fi

  print_target_dirs dirs
  echo

  if $DRY_RUN; then
    info "DRY RUN — no files will be modified."
    echo
  elif ! $FORCE; then
    confirm "${#dirs[@]}"
    echo
  fi

  phase_delete dirs
  echo
  phase_recreate

  echo
  if $DRY_RUN; then
    info "Dry run complete. Re-run without --dry-run to apply changes."
  else
    success "Done."
  fi
}

main "$@"

Everything checks out. Here's the full picture:

---

## `asset-rebuild` — what was built

### Files created

```
asset-rebuild                          ← the main command
.asset-templates/
├── manifest.json                      ← declares every asset to recreate
└── scripts/
    ├── gen-font.sh                    ← example: font subsetting generator
    └── gen-resize.sh                  ← example: image resize generator
```

---

### How it works — two phases

**Phase 1 — Delete**
Walks every asset directory (auto-discovered or explicitly specified), finds files whose extension matches the binary asset list **and** whose size is ≥ the threshold (default 100 KB), and deletes them recursively.

**Phase 2 — Recreate**
Reads `.asset-templates/manifest.json`. Each entry maps a template file to one or more output paths, with two modes:
- **Copy** — no `generator` key → template is `cp`'d to each target
- **Generate** — `generator` key → a custom script is called as `<script> <template_path> <target_path> [args...]`, letting you use ImageMagick, pyftsubset, ffmpeg, etc.

---

### Usage

```bash
# Dry run — see exactly what would happen, nothing is touched
./asset-rebuild --dry-run

# Real run with confirmation prompt
./asset-rebuild

# Skip prompt (CI)
./asset-rebuild --force

# Smaller threshold (delete anything ≥ 10 KB)
./asset-rebuild --size-threshold 10240

# Target specific directories only
./asset-rebuild public/images assets/fonts

# Custom template dir + verbose output
./asset-rebuild --template-dir ./my-templates --verbose

# Add extra extensions beyond the built-in list
./asset-rebuild --extension xcf --extension raw
```

---

### Integration with the post-checkout hook

The command reads `.git/asset-dirs.txt` (written by the hook) automatically — no need to specify directories manually. The typical flow after a branch switch becomes:

```
git checkout feature/redesign
  → post-checkout runs → discovers + lists asset dirs → writes .git/asset-dirs.txt
  → asset-rebuild reads .git/asset-dirs.txt → deletes stale large assets → recreates from templates
```

You can wire `asset-rebuild --force` directly into the post-checkout hook when you want fully automatic regeneration on every checkout.

---

### Manifest entry structure

| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `template` | ✅ | Filename inside `.asset-templates/` |
| `targets` | ✅ | Array of repo-relative output paths |
| `generator` | ❌ | Repo-relative path to an executable script |
| `generator_args` | ❌ | Extra args appended after template + target |

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# asset-rebuild
#
# Recursively deletes large binary assets across all identified asset
# directories, then recreates them from source templates.
#
# USAGE
#   asset-rebuild [OPTIONS] [TARGET_DIR ...]
#
# OPTIONS
#   -t, --template-dir DIR   Directory containing source templates and the
#                            asset manifest. Default: .asset-templates/
#   -m, --manifest FILE      Path to the asset manifest (JSON). Default:
#                            <template-dir>/manifest.json
#   -s, --size-threshold N   Only delete files >= N bytes. Default: 102400 (100 KB)
#   -e, --extension EXT      Extra binary extension to target (repeatable).
#   -n, --dry-run            Show what would happen without changing anything.
#   -f, --force              Skip the confirmation prompt.
#   -v, --verbose            Print every file processed.
#   -h, --help               Show this help text.
#
# TARGET_DIR
#   One or more asset directories to operate on. If omitted, directories are
#   auto-discovered (from .git/asset-dirs.txt if present, otherwise via a
#   live scan identical to the post-checkout hook).
#
# MANIFEST FORMAT  (.asset-templates/manifest.json)
#   A JSON array of template entries:
#
#   [
#     {
#       "template": "placeholder-image.png",   // file inside template-dir
#       "targets": [                            // repo-relative output paths
#         "public/images/hero.png",
#         "public/images/logo.png"
#       ],
#       "generator": "scripts/gen-image.sh",   // optional: run instead of copy
#       "generator_args": ["--width=1920"]      // extra args passed to generator
#     },
#     {
#       "template": "blank.woff2",
#       "targets": ["assets/fonts/custom.woff2"]
#     }
#   ]
#
#   If "generator" is set the script is called as:
#     <generator> <template_path> <target_path> [generator_args...]
#   and is expected to produce the target file itself.
#   If "generator" is absent the template is simply copied to each target.
#
# TEMPLATE DIRECTORY LAYOUT
#   .asset-templates/
#   ├── manifest.json
#   ├── placeholder-image.png
#   ├── blank.woff2
#   └── scripts/
#       └── gen-image.sh
#
# EXIT CODES
#   0  Success

[389 more lines in file. Use offset=61 to continue.]

#   1  Usage / argument error
#   2  Missing required file (manifest, template)
#   3  Generator script failed
#   4  Aborted by user

set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Defaults
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
TEMPLATE_DIR=".asset-templates"
MANIFEST_FILE=""            # resolved after TEMPLATE_DIR is known
SIZE_THRESHOLD=102400       # 100 KB
DRY_RUN=false
FORCE=false
VERBOSE=false
EXTRA_EXTENSIONS=()
TARGET_DIRS=()

# Binary extensions — kept in sync with post-checkout hook
ASSET_EXTENSIONS=(
  png jpg jpeg gif webp avif svg ico bmp tiff
  mp4 webm mov avi mkv ogv
  mp3 wav ogg flac aac m4a
  woff woff2 ttf otf eot
  pdf
  zip tar gz
  glb gltf obj fbx
  psd ai sketch fig
)

ASSET_DIR_NAMES=(
  assets static public media images imgs icons fonts
  videos audio sounds svg sprites textures
  i18n locale locales dist build out
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Logging helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
RED='\033[0;31m'; YELLOW='\033[1;33m'; GREEN='\033[0;32m'
CYAN='\033[0;36m'; BOLD='\033[1m'; RESET='\033[0m'

info()    { echo -e "${CYAN}[asset-rebuild]${RESET} $*"; }
success() { echo -e "${GREEN}[asset-rebuild]${RESET} $*"; }
warn()    { echo -e "${YELLOW}[asset-rebuild] WARN:${RESET} $*" >&2; }
error()   { echo -e "${RED}[asset-rebuild] ERROR:${RESET} $*" >&2; }
verbose() { $VERBOSE && echo -e "  ${BOLD}↳${RESET} $*" || true; }
die()     { error "$*"; exit 1; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Usage
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
usage() {
  sed -n '/^# USAGE/,/^# EXIT CODES/{ /^# EXIT CODES/d; s/^# \{0,1\}//; p }' "$0"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Argument parsing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
parse_args() {
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      -t|--template-dir)   TEMPLATE_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      -m|--manifest)       MANIFEST_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      -s|--size-threshold) SIZE_THRESHOLD="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      -e|--extension)      EXTRA_EXTENSIONS+=("$2"); shift 2 ;;
      -n|--dry-run)        DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
      -f|--force)          FORCE=true; shift ;;
      -v|--verbose)        VERBOSE=true; shift ;;
      -h|--help)           usage; exit 0 ;;
      --) shift; TARGET_DIRS+=("$@"); break ;;
      -*) die "Unknown option: $1  (try --help)" ;;
      *)  TARGET_DIRS+=("$1"); shift ;;
    esac
  done

  # Merge extra extensions
  ASSET_EXTENSIONS+=("${EXTRA_EXTENSIONS[@]}")

  # Resolve manifest path
  [[ -z "$MANIFEST_FILE" ]] && MANIFEST_FILE="$TEMPLATE_DIR/manifest.json"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Resolve repo root (works inside or outside a git repo)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resolve_repo_root() {
  if git rev-parse --show-toplevel &>/dev/null 2>&1; then
    git rev-parse --show-toplevel
  else
    pwd
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Asset-directory discovery (mirrors post-checkout hook logic)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
discover_asset_dirs() {
  local repo_root="$1"
  local -n _out_dirs="$2"   # nameref to caller's array

  # Prefer the pre-built list from the post-checkout hook
  local cached="$repo_root/.git/asset-dirs.txt"
  if [[ -f "$cached" ]]; then
    info "Using cached asset directory list from .git/asset-dirs.txt"
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      [[ -n "$line" && -d "$repo_root/$line" ]] && _out_dirs+=("$repo_root/$line")
    done < "$cached"
    return
  fi

  info "No cached list found — running live asset directory scan..."

  declare -A _seen

  # Strategy 1: directory names
  local find_args=()
  for name in "${ASSET_DIR_NAMES[@]}"; do
    find_args+=( -o -name "$name" )
  done
  unset 'find_args[0]'

  while IFS= read -r -d '' dir; do
    [[ "$dir" == "$repo_root/.git"* ]] && continue
    local rel
    rel="$(realpath --relative-to="$repo_root" "$dir" 2>/dev/null || echo "$dir")"
    [[ -z "${_seen[$rel]+_}" ]] && { _seen[$rel]=1; _out_dirs+=("$dir"); }
  done < <(find "$repo_root" \
    \( -path "$repo_root/.git" -prune \) \
    -o -type d \( "${find_args[@]}" \) -print0 2>/dev/null)

  # Strategy 2: tracked file extensions
  if git -C "$repo_root" rev-parse HEAD &>/dev/null 2>&1; then
    local joined; joined="$(IFS='|'; echo "${ASSET_EXTENSIONS[*]}")"
    local ext_pat="\.(${joined})$"
    while IFS= read -r file; do
      local dir; dir="$repo_root/$(dirname "$file")"
      [[ "$(dirname "$file")" == "." ]] && continue
      local rel; rel="$(realpath --relative-to="$repo_root" "$dir" 2>/dev/null || echo "$dir")"
      [[ -z "${_seen[$rel]+_}" ]] && { _seen[$rel]=1; _out_dirs+=("$dir"); }
    done < <(git -C "$repo_root" ls-files 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei "$ext_pat" || true)
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the extension grep pattern
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ext_pattern() {
  local joined; joined="$(IFS='|'; echo "${ASSET_EXTENSIONS[*]}")"
  echo "\.(${joined})$"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PHASE 1 — Find and delete large binary assets
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
phase_delete() {
  local -n _dirs="$1"
  local pattern; pattern="$(ext_pattern)"
  local deleted=0
  local skipped=0

  info "Phase 1: scanning for large binary assets (>= $(numfmt --to=iec "$SIZE_THRESHOLD" 2>/dev/null || echo "${SIZE_THRESHOLD} bytes"))..."

  for dir in "${_dirs[@]}"; do
    [[ ! -d "$dir" ]] && { warn "Directory not found, skipping: $dir"; continue; }

    while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
      local size
      size="$(stat -c%s "$file" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"

      if (( size >= SIZE_THRESHOLD )); then
        local rel_file; rel_file="$(realpath --relative-to="$REPO_ROOT" "$file")"
        local human_size; human_size="$(numfmt --to=iec "$size" 2>/dev/null || echo "${size}B")"
        verbose "DELETE  $rel_file  ($human_size)"

        if ! $DRY_RUN; then
          rm -f "$file"
        fi
        (( deleted++ )) || true
      else
        (( skipped++ )) || true
      fi
    done < <(find "$dir" -type f -print0 2>/dev/null \
      | grep -zEi "$pattern" || true)
  done

  if $DRY_RUN; then
    info "  [dry-run] Would delete $deleted file(s) ($skipped below threshold, kept)."
  else
    success "  Deleted $deleted large binary asset(s). ($skipped below threshold, kept)"
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dependency check: jq is required for manifest parsing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
require_jq() {
  if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
    die "jq is required for manifest parsing. Install it: https://stedolan.github.io/jq/"
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PHASE 2 — Recreate assets from source templates
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
phase_recreate() {
  [[ ! -f "$MANIFEST_FILE" ]] && {
    warn "No manifest found at '$MANIFEST_FILE' — skipping recreation phase."
    warn "Create $MANIFEST_FILE to define templates. See --help for the format."
    return 0
  }

  require_jq

  local entry_count; entry_count="$(jq 'length' "$MANIFEST_FILE")"
  info "Phase 2: recreating assets from $entry_count template entry/entries in $MANIFEST_FILE..."

  local created=0
  local failed=0

  for i in $(seq 0 $(( entry_count - 1 ))); do
    local template target_json generator generator_args_json

    template="$(jq -r ".[$i].template" "$MANIFEST_FILE")"
    target_json="$(jq -c ".[$i].targets" "$MANIFEST_FILE")"
    generator="$(jq -r ".[$i].generator // empty" "$MANIFEST_FILE")"
    generator_args_json="$(jq -c ".[$i].generator_args // []" "$MANIFEST_FILE")"

    local template_path="$TEMPLATE_DIR/$template"

    if [[ ! -f "$template_path" ]]; then
      error "Template not found: $template_path  (entry $i)"
      (( failed++ )) || true
      continue
    fi

    # Read targets into an array
    local targets=()
    while IFS= read -r t; do
      targets+=("$t")
    done < <(echo "$target_json" | jq -r '.[]')

    # Read generator_args into an array
    local generator_args=()
    while IFS= read -r a; do
      generator_args+=("$a")
    done < <(echo "$generator_args_json" | jq -r '.[]')

    for target in "${targets[@]}"; do
      local target_path="$REPO_ROOT/$target"
      local target_dir; target_dir="$(dirname "$target_path")"
      local rel_target; rel_target="$(realpath --relative-to="$REPO_ROOT" "$target_path" 2>/dev/null || echo "$target")"

      if $DRY_RUN; then
        if [[ -n "$generator" ]]; then
          verbose "GENERATE  $rel_target  via $generator"
        else
          verbose "COPY      $rel_target  ← $template"
        fi
        (( created++ )) || true
        continue
      fi

      # Ensure parent directory exists
      mkdir -p "$target_dir"

      if [[ -n "$generator" ]]; then
        # Run the custom generator
        local gen_path="$REPO_ROOT/$generator"
        if [[ ! -x "$gen_path" ]]; then
          error "Generator not found or not executable: $gen_path  (entry $i)"
          (( failed++ )) || true
          continue
        fi

        verbose "GENERATE  $rel_target  via $generator"
        if ! "$gen_path" "$template_path" "$target_path" "${generator_args[@]}" 2>&1; then
          error "Generator failed for: $rel_target"
          (( failed++ )) || true
          continue
        fi
      else
        # Default: plain copy, preserving timestamps
        verbose "COPY      $rel_target  ← $template"
        cp -p "$template_path" "$target_path"
      fi

      (( created++ )) || true
    done
  done

  if $DRY_RUN; then
    info "  [dry-run] Would recreate $created file(s). ($failed error(s))"
  else
    if (( failed > 0 )); then
      warn "  Recreated $created file(s) with $failed error(s)."
    else
      success "  Recreated $created file(s) successfully."
    fi
  fi

  return $(( failed > 0 ? 3 : 0 ))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Confirmation prompt
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
confirm() {
  local dirs_count="$1"
  echo
  echo -e "${YELLOW}${BOLD}⚠  WARNING: This will permanently delete large binary files.${RESET}"
  echo    "   Asset directories targeted : $dirs_count"
  echo    "   Size threshold             : >= $(numfmt --to=iec "$SIZE_THRESHOLD" 2>/dev/null || echo "${SIZE_THRESHOLD} B")"
  echo    "   Template directory         : $TEMPLATE_DIR"
  echo    "   Manifest                   : $MANIFEST_FILE"
  echo
  echo -n "   Proceed? [y/N] "
  read -r answer
  [[ "$answer" =~ ^[Yy]$ ]] || { info "Aborted."; exit 4; }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarise what directories will be targeted
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
print_target_dirs() {
  local -n _dirs="$1"
  info "Target asset directories (${#_dirs[@]}):"
  for d in "${_dirs[@]}"; do
    echo "    → $(realpath --relative-to="$REPO_ROOT" "$d" 2>/dev/null || echo "$d")"
  done
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
main() {
  parse_args "$@"

  REPO_ROOT="$(resolve_repo_root)"
  cd "$REPO_ROOT"

  # Make TEMPLATE_DIR absolute if relative
  [[ "$TEMPLATE_DIR" != /* ]] && TEMPLATE_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/$TEMPLATE_DIR"
  [[ "$MANIFEST_FILE" != /* ]] && MANIFEST_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/$MANIFEST_FILE"

  # Resolve target directories
  local dirs=()
  if [[ ${#TARGET_DIRS[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    for d in "${TARGET_DIRS[@]}"; do
      [[ "$d" != /* ]] && d="$REPO_ROOT/$d"
      [[ -d "$d" ]] || die "Specified directory does not exist: $d"
      dirs+=("$d")
    done
  else
    discover_asset_dirs "$REPO_ROOT" dirs
  fi

  if [[ ${#dirs[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    warn "No asset directories found. Nothing to do."
    warn "Pass explicit directories as arguments, or create asset directories first."
    exit 0
  fi

  print_target_dirs dirs
  echo

  if $DRY_RUN; then
    info "DRY RUN — no files will be modified."
    echo
  elif ! $FORCE; then
    confirm "${#dirs[@]}"
    echo
  fi

  phase_delete dirs
  echo
  phase_recreate

  echo
  if $DRY_RUN; then
    info "Dry run complete. Re-run without --dry-run to apply changes."
  else
    success "Done."
  fi
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# gen-image.sh — resource-intensive image processing generator
#
# Called by asset-rebuild as:
#   gen-image.sh <template_path> <target_path> [OPTIONS]
#
# OPTIONS (passed via manifest generator_args)
#   --width=N              Output width in pixels (default: derived from filename or 1920)
#   --height=N             Output height in pixels (default: derived from filename or 1080)
#   --quality=N            JPEG/WebP quality 1-100 (default: 85)
#   --format=FMT           Force output format: jpeg|png|webp|avif (default: from extension)
#   --mode=MODE            Resize mode: fill|fit|crop|stretch (default: fill)
#   --gravity=G            Crop gravity: Center|North|South|NorthWest|etc (default: Center)
#   --blur=SIGMA           Apply Gaussian blur with given sigma (default: off)
#   --sharpen=RADIUS:SIGMA Apply unsharp mask (default: 0.5:0.5 when --blur is not set)
#   --watermark=FILE       Overlay watermark image (repo-relative path)
#   --watermark-gravity=G  Watermark placement gravity (default: SouthEast)
#   --watermark-opacity=N  Watermark opacity 0-100 (default: 30)
#   --strip-exif           Strip all metadata (default: on)
#   --no-strip-exif        Preserve metadata
#   --colorspace=CS        Convert to colorspace: sRGB|Gray|CMYK (default: sRGB)
#   --dither               Apply Floyd-Steinberg dithering (PNG/GIF)
#   --progressive          Progressive/interlaced encode (JPEG/PNG)
#   --passes=N             Number of optimisation passes (default: 2)
#   --threads=N            Limit ImageMagick threads (default: nproc)
#   --profile=FILE         Embed ICC colour profile (repo-relative path)
#
# DEPENDENCIES
#   Required:  ImageMagick (convert, identify, mogrify)
#   Optional:  cwebp (better WebP), avifenc (AVIF), pngcrush/optipng (PNG opt),
#              jpegoptim/mozjpeg (JPEG opt), exiftool (metadata stripping)

set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Args
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
TEMPLATE="$1"
TARGET="$2"
shift 2

WIDTH=""
HEIGHT=""
QUALITY=85
FORMAT=""
MODE="fill"
GRAVITY="Center"
BLUR=""
SHARPEN="0.5x0.5+0+0"   # unsharp mask default
DO_SHARPEN=true
WATERMARK=""
WM_GRAVITY="SouthEast"
WM_OPACITY=30
STRIP_EXIF=true
COLORSPACE="sRGB"
DITHER=false
PROGRESSIVE=false
PASSES=2
THREADS="$(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.logicalcpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4)"
ICC_PROFILE=""

for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --width=*)             WIDTH="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --height=*)            HEIGHT="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --quality=*)           QUALITY="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --format=*)            FORMAT="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --mode=*)              MODE="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --gravity=*)           GRAVITY="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --blur=*)              BLUR="${arg#*=}"; DO_SHARPEN=false ;;
    --sharpen=*)           SHARPEN="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --watermark=*)         WATERMARK="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --watermark-gravity=*) WM_GRAVITY="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --watermark-opacity=*) WM_OPACITY="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --strip-exif)          STRIP_EXIF=true ;;
    --no-strip-exif)       STRIP_EXIF=false ;;
    --colorspace=*)        COLORSPACE="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --dither)              DITHER=true ;;
    --progressive)         PROGRESSIVE=true ;;
    --passes=*)            PASSES="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --threads=*)           THREADS="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --profile=*)           ICC_PROFILE="${arg#*=}" ;;
    *) echo "[gen-image] WARNING: unknown arg: $arg" >&2 ;;
  esac
done

REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dependency check
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ! command -v convert &>/dev/null; then
  echo "[gen-image] ERROR: ImageMagick 'convert' not found. Install ImageMagick." >&2
  exit 2
fi

IM_VERSION="$(convert --version | head -1)"
echo "[gen-image] Using: $IM_VERSION"
echo "[gen-image] Template : $TEMPLATE"
echo "[gen-image] Target   : $TARGET"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Infer dimensions from filename if not explicitly set
# e.g. hero-1920x1080.png → 1920, 1080
#      tile-512.png       → 512x512
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
BASENAME="$(basename "$TARGET" | sed 's/\.[^.]*$//')"

if [[ -z "$WIDTH" || -z "$HEIGHT" ]]; then
  if [[ "$BASENAME" =~ ([0-9]+)x([0-9]+) ]]; then
    WIDTH="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    HEIGHT="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
  elif [[ "$BASENAME" =~ ([0-9]+)$ ]]; then
    DIM="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    WIDTH="$DIM"
    HEIGHT="$DIM"
  else
    # Fall back to template's native dimensions
    NATIVE="$(identify -format "%wx%h" "$TEMPLATE" 2>/dev/null || echo "1920x1080")"
    WIDTH="${NATIVE%%x*}"
    HEIGHT="${NATIVE##*x}"
  fi
fi

# Infer output format from target extension
if [[ -z "$FORMAT" ]]; then
  EXT="${TARGET##*.}"
  FORMAT="${EXT,,}"
fi

echo "[gen-image] Output   : ${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT} format=${FORMAT} quality=${QUALITY} mode=${MODE}"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the ImageMagick pipeline
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export MAGICK_THREAD_LIMIT="$THREADS"

# Intermediate work file (lossless PNG for multi-pass safety)
WORKDIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORKDIR"' EXIT

WORK1="$WORKDIR/pass1.png"
WORK2="$WORKDIR/pass2.png"
WORK_FINAL="$WORKDIR/final.${FORMAT}"

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$TARGET")"

# -- Pass 1: geometry + colorspace + initial quality ops --
echo "[gen-image] Pass 1/$(( PASSES )): geometry + colorspace transform..."

RESIZE_ARGS=()
case "$MODE" in
  fill)
    # Fill the box, then center-crop — most CPU-intensive path
    RESIZE_ARGS+=( -resize "${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT}^" -gravity "$GRAVITY" -extent "${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT}" )
    ;;
  fit)
    RESIZE_ARGS+=( -resize "${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT}" -background transparent -gravity "$GRAVITY" -extent "${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT}" )
    ;;
  crop)
    RESIZE_ARGS+=( -gravity "$GRAVITY" -crop "${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT}+0+0" +repage )
    ;;
  stretch)
    RESIZE_ARGS+=( -resize "${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT}!" )
    ;;
  *)
    echo "[gen-image] Unknown mode '$MODE', defaulting to fill" >&2
    RESIZE_ARGS+=( -resize "${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT}^" -gravity "$GRAVITY" -extent "${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT}" )
    ;;
esac

convert "$TEMPLATE" \
  -colorspace "$COLORSPACE" \
  "${RESIZE_ARGS[@]}" \
  -depth 8 \
  "$WORK1"

# -- Pass 2: sharpening / blur + colour optimisation --
echo "[gen-image] Pass 2/$(( PASSES )): sharpening / blur + colour correction..."

FILTER_ARGS=()

if [[ -n "$BLUR" ]]; then
  echo "[gen-image]   Applying Gaussian blur sigma=${BLUR}"
  FILTER_ARGS+=( -blur "0x${BLUR}" )
elif $DO_SHARPEN; then
  echo "[gen-image]   Applying unsharp mask ${SHARPEN}"
  FILTER_ARGS+=( -unsharp "$SHARPEN" )
fi

# Histogram normalisation for richer output (computationally heavier)
FILTER_ARGS+=( -normalize )

# Auto-levels on each channel independently
FILTER_ARGS+=( -auto-level )

# Moderate contrast boost
FILTER_ARGS+=( -sigmoidal-contrast "3,50%" )

$DITHER && FILTER_ARGS+=( -dither FloydSteinberg )

convert "$WORK1" \
  "${FILTER_ARGS[@]}" \
  "$WORK2"

# -- Additional passes (if PASSES > 2) --
CURRENT_WORK="$WORK2"
if (( PASSES > 2 )); then
  for (( p=3; p<=PASSES; p++ )); do
    NEXT_WORK="$WORKDIR/pass${p}.png"
    echo "[gen-image] Pass ${p}/${PASSES}: extra optimisation pass..."
    # Additional unsharp + subtle saturation boost per extra pass
    convert "$CURRENT_WORK" \
      -unsharp "0.3x0.3+0.5+0" \
      -modulate "100,105,100" \
      "$NEXT_WORK"
    CURRENT_WORK="$NEXT_WORK"
  done
fi

# -- ICC profile embedding --
if [[ -n "$ICC_PROFILE" ]]; then
  ICC_PATH="$REPO_ROOT/$ICC_PROFILE"
  if [[ -f "$ICC_PATH" ]]; then
    echo "[gen-image]   Embedding ICC profile: $ICC_PROFILE"
    convert "$CURRENT_WORK" -profile "$ICC_PATH" "$CURRENT_WORK.profiled.png"
    CURRENT_WORK="$CURRENT_WORK.profiled.png"
  else
    echo "[gen-image] WARNING: ICC profile not found: $ICC_PATH" >&2
  fi
fi

# -- Watermark compositing --
if [[ -n "$WATERMARK" ]]; then
  WM_PATH="$REPO_ROOT/$WATERMARK"
  if [[ -f "$WM_PATH" ]]; then
    echo "[gen-image]   Compositing watermark (gravity=${WM_GRAVITY} opacity=${WM_OPACITY}%)"
    WM_WORK="$WORKDIR/watermarked.png"
    # Scale watermark to 20% of output width
    WM_W=$(( WIDTH / 5 ))
    convert "$WM_PATH" -resize "${WM_W}x" -alpha set \
      -channel Alpha -evaluate Multiply "0.$(printf '%02d' "$WM_OPACITY")" +channel \
      "$WORKDIR/wm_scaled.png"
    convert "$CURRENT_WORK" "$WORKDIR/wm_scaled.png" \
      -gravity "$WM_GRAVITY" -geometry +10+10 \
      -composite "$WM_WORK"
    CURRENT_WORK="$WM_WORK"
  else
    echo "[gen-image] WARNING: watermark not found: $WM_PATH" >&2
  fi
fi

# -- Final encode --
echo "[gen-image] Final encode → $FORMAT..."

ENCODE_ARGS=()
$STRIP_EXIF && ENCODE_ARGS+=( -strip )
$PROGRESSIVE && {
  case "$FORMAT" in
    jpg|jpeg) ENCODE_ARGS+=( -interlace Plane ) ;;
    png)      ENCODE_ARGS+=( -interlace PNG ) ;;
  esac
}

case "$FORMAT" in
  jpg|jpeg)
    ENCODE_ARGS+=( -quality "$QUALITY" -sampling-factor 4:2:0 )
    convert "$CURRENT_WORK" "${ENCODE_ARGS[@]}" -format JPEG "$TARGET"
    ;;
  png)
    # PNG compression level 0-9 (map quality 0-100 → level 9-0)
    PNG_LEVEL=$(( 9 - ( QUALITY * 9 / 100 ) ))
    ENCODE_ARGS+=( -define png:compression-level="$PNG_LEVEL" )
    ENCODE_ARGS+=( -define png:compression-filter=5 )
    ENCODE_ARGS+=( -define png:compression-strategy=1 )
    convert "$CURRENT_WORK" "${ENCODE_ARGS[@]}" "$TARGET"
    ;;
  webp)
    if command -v cwebp &>/dev/null; then
      echo "[gen-image]   Using cwebp for superior WebP compression..."
      # Convert to raw BMP first for cwebp compatibility
      convert "$CURRENT_WORK" "${ENCODE_ARGS[@]}" "$WORKDIR/intermediate.bmp"
      cwebp -q "$QUALITY" -m 6 -pass 10 -mt -af \
        "$WORKDIR/intermediate.bmp" -o "$TARGET"
    else
      ENCODE_ARGS+=( -quality "$QUALITY" -define webp:method=6 -define webp:auto-filter=true )
      convert "$CURRENT_WORK" "${ENCODE_ARGS[@]}" "$TARGET"
    fi
    ;;
  avif)
    if command -v avifenc &>/dev/null; then
      echo "[gen-image]   Using avifenc for AVIF encoding..."
      convert "$CURRENT_WORK" "${ENCODE_ARGS[@]}" "$WORKDIR/intermediate.png"
      AVIF_QUALITY=$(( 63 - ( QUALITY * 63 / 100 ) ))  # avifenc: 0=best, 63=worst
      avifenc --jobs "$THREADS" --speed 0 --min "$AVIF_QUALITY" --max "$AVIF_QUALITY" \
        "$WORKDIR/intermediate.png" "$TARGET"
    else
      convert "$CURRENT_WORK" "${ENCODE_ARGS[@]}" "$TARGET"
    fi
    ;;
  gif)
    ENCODE_ARGS+=( -layers Optimize )
    $DITHER && ENCODE_ARGS+=( -dither FloydSteinberg )
    convert "$CURRENT_WORK" "${ENCODE_ARGS[@]}" "$TARGET"
    ;;
  *)
    convert "$CURRENT_WORK" "${ENCODE_ARGS[@]}" "$TARGET"
    ;;
esac

# -- Post-encode optimisation (optional tooling) --
case "$FORMAT" in
  jpg|jpeg)
    if command -v jpegoptim &>/dev/null; then
      echo "[gen-image]   jpegoptim post-optimisation..."
      jpegoptim --max="$QUALITY" --strip-all --all-progressive "$TARGET"
    elif command -v mozjpeg &>/dev/null; then
      echo "[gen-image]   mozjpeg post-optimisation..."
      mozjpeg -quality "$QUALITY" -progressive -copy none "$TARGET" > "$TARGET.moz" \
        && mv "$TARGET.moz" "$TARGET"
    fi
    ;;
  png)
    if command -v optipng &>/dev/null; then
      echo "[gen-image]   optipng post-optimisation..."
      optipng -o5 -strip all "$TARGET"
    elif command -v pngcrush &>/dev/null; then
      echo "[gen-image]   pngcrush post-optimisation..."
      pngcrush -ow -rem allb -reduce "$TARGET"
    fi
    ;;
esac

# -- Final metadata strip via exiftool if available --
if $STRIP_EXIF && command -v exiftool &>/dev/null; then
  exiftool -all= -overwrite_original_in_place "$TARGET" &>/dev/null || true
fi

# -- Report --
SRC_SIZE="$(stat -c%s "$TEMPLATE" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$TEMPLATE" 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
OUT_SIZE="$(stat -c%s "$TARGET"   2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$TARGET"   2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
echo "[gen-image] Done: $TARGET"
echo "[gen-image]   Source size : $(numfmt --to=iec "$SRC_SIZE" 2>/dev/null || echo "${SRC_SIZE}B")"
echo "[gen-image]   Output size : $(numfmt --to=iec "$OUT_SIZE" 2>/dev/null || echo "${OUT_SIZE}B")"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# gen-video.sh — resource-intensive video transcoding generator
#
# Called by asset-rebuild as:
#   gen-video.sh <template_path> <target_path> [OPTIONS]
#
# OPTIONS (passed via manifest generator_args)
#   --codec=CODEC          Video codec: h264|h265|vp9|av1|copy (default: h264)
#   --audio-codec=CODEC    Audio codec: aac|opus|mp3|copy|none (default: aac)
#   --width=N              Output width in pixels (height auto; default: from source)
#   --height=N             Output height in pixels (width auto; default: from source)
#   --scale=WxH            Explicit WxH (overrides --width/--height)
#   --bitrate=N[k|M]       Target video bitrate (default: 2000k)
#   --audio-bitrate=N[k]   Target audio bitrate (default: 128k)
#   --crf=N                CRF quality (overrides --bitrate for CRF-based encode)
#                            h264: 0-51 (18 = great, 28 = default)
#                            h265: 0-51 (24 = great, 28 = default)
#                            vp9:  0-63 (31 = default)
#                            av1:  0-63 (30 = default)
#   --preset=PRESET        Encoding speed preset (default: slow)
#                            h264/h265: ultrafast|superfast|veryfast|faster|fast|medium|slow|slower|veryslow
#                            av1: 0 (slowest) – 8 (fastest)
#   --passes=N             1 or 2-pass encode (default: 2; ignored for CRF)
#   --fps=N                Force frame rate (default: preserve source)
#   --hdr-to-sdr           Apply HDR→SDR tonemapping (requires HDR source)
#   --deinterlace          Apply yadif deinterlacing
#   --denoise=LEVEL        Apply hqdn3d denoise: light|medium|heavy (default: off)
#   --thumbnail            Generate a thumbnail sprite sheet alongside the video
#   --thumbnail-interval=N Sprite thumbnail every N seconds (default: 10)
#   --normalize-audio      Apply loudnorm EBU R128 audio normalisation (2-pass)
#   --audio-only           Discard video, transcode audio stream only
#   --no-audio             Discard audio stream
#   --format=FMT           Container: mp4|webm|mkv|mov (default: from extension)
#   --threads=N            CPU threads (default: nproc)
#   --hwaccel=ACCEL        Hardware acceleration: vaapi|nvenc|videotoolbox|none (default: none)
#   --start=TIME           Trim start (HH:MM:SS or seconds)
#   --duration=TIME        Trim duration (HH:MM:SS or seconds)
#   --watermark=FILE       Burn-in text or image watermark (repo-relative path or text)
#   --watermark-text=TEXT  Burn-in text string (uses drawtext filter)
#
# DEPENDENCIES
#   Required:  ffmpeg (with libx264, libvpx-vp9, libopus, libfdk_aac or aac)
#   Optional:  ffprobe (source inspection), bc (bitrate math)

set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Args
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
TEMPLATE="$1"
TARGET="$2"
shift 2

CODEC="h264"
AUDIO_CODEC="aac"
WIDTH=""
HEIGHT=""
SCALE=""
BITRATE="2000k"
AUDIO_BITRATE="128k"
CRF=""
PRESET="slow"
PASSES=2
FPS=""
HDR_TO_SDR=false
DEINTERLACE=false
DENOISE=""
THUMBNAIL=false
THUMB_INTERVAL=10
NORMALIZE_AUDIO=false
AUDIO_ONLY=false
NO_AUDIO=false
FORMAT=""
THREADS="$(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.logicalcpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4)"
HWACCEL="none"
TRIM_START=""
TRIM_DURATION=""
WATERMARK_FILE=""
WATERMARK_TEXT=""

for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --codec=*)             CODEC="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --audio-codec=*)       AUDIO_CODEC="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --width=*)             WIDTH="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --height=*)            HEIGHT="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --scale=*)             SCALE="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --bitrate=*)           BITRATE="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --audio-bitrate=*)     AUDIO_BITRATE="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --crf=*)               CRF="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --preset=*)            PRESET="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --passes=*)            PASSES="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --fps=*)               FPS="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --hdr-to-sdr)          HDR_TO_SDR=true ;;
    --deinterlace)         DEINTERLACE=true ;;
    --denoise=*)           DENOISE="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --thumbnail)           THUMBNAIL=true ;;
    --thumbnail-interval=*) THUMB_INTERVAL="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --normalize-audio)     NORMALIZE_AUDIO=true ;;
    --audio-only)          AUDIO_ONLY=true ;;
    --no-audio)            NO_AUDIO=true ;;
    --format=*)            FORMAT="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --threads=*)           THREADS="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --hwaccel=*)           HWACCEL="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --start=*)             TRIM_START="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --duration=*)          TRIM_DURATION="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --watermark=*)         WATERMARK_FILE="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --watermark-text=*)    WATERMARK_TEXT="${arg#*=}" ;;
    *) echo "[gen-video] WARNING: unknown arg: $arg" >&2 ;;
  esac
done

REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dependency check
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ! command -v ffmpeg &>/dev/null; then
  echo "[gen-video] ERROR: ffmpeg not found. Install ffmpeg." >&2
  exit 2
fi

FFMPEG_VERSION="$(ffmpeg -version 2>&1 | head -1)"
echo "[gen-video] Using: $FFMPEG_VERSION"
echo "[gen-video] Template : $TEMPLATE"
echo "[gen-video] Target   : $TARGET"
echo "[gen-video] Codec    : $CODEC | Preset: $PRESET | Threads: $THREADS"

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$TARGET")"
WORKDIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORKDIR"' EXIT

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Probe source
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
probe_source() {
  if command -v ffprobe &>/dev/null; then
    ffprobe -v quiet -print_format json -show_streams -show_format "$TEMPLATE" \
      2>/dev/null || echo '{}'
  else
    echo '{}'
  fi
}

echo "[gen-video] Probing source..."
PROBE="$(probe_source)"

# Extract source resolution
SRC_W="$(echo "$PROBE" | grep -oP '"width"\s*:\s*\K[0-9]+' | head -1 || echo 1920)"
SRC_H="$(echo "$PROBE" | grep -oP '"height"\s*:\s*\K[0-9]+' | head -1 || echo 1080)"
SRC_FPS_RAW="$(echo "$PROBE" | grep -oP '"r_frame_rate"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+' | head -1 || echo '30/1')"
SRC_DURATION="$(echo "$PROBE" | grep -oP '"duration"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+' | head -1 || echo '0')"
echo "[gen-video]   Source: ${SRC_W}x${SRC_H} fps=${SRC_FPS_RAW} duration=${SRC_DURATION}s"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Infer output format from target extension
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[ -z "$FORMAT" ]] && FORMAT="${TARGET##*.}"
FORMAT="${FORMAT,,}"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build video filter chain
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
build_vf() {
  local filters=()

  # Scale
  if [[ -n "$SCALE" ]]; then
    filters+=( "scale=${SCALE}:flags=lanczos" )
  elif [[ -n "$WIDTH" && -n "$HEIGHT" ]]; then
    filters+=( "scale=${WIDTH}:${HEIGHT}:flags=lanczos" )
  elif [[ -n "$WIDTH" ]]; then
    filters+=( "scale=${WIDTH}:-2:flags=lanczos" )
  elif [[ -n "$HEIGHT" ]]; then
    filters+=( "scale=-2:${HEIGHT}:flags=lanczos" )
  fi

  # Deinterlace
  $DEINTERLACE && filters+=( "yadif=mode=1:parity=-1:deint=0" )

  # Denoise
  case "${DENOISE:-}" in
    light)  filters+=( "hqdn3d=2:1:2:3" ) ;;
    medium) filters+=( "hqdn3d=4:3:6:4.5" ) ;;
    heavy)  filters+=( "hqdn3d=8:6:12:9" ) ;;
  esac

  # HDR→SDR tonemapping (zscale + tonemap)
  if $HDR_TO_SDR; then
    filters+=(
      "zscale=t=linear:npl=100"
      "format=gbrpf32le"
      "zscale=p=bt709"
      "tonemap=hable:desat=0"
      "zscale=t=bt709:m=bt709:r=tv"
      "format=yuv420p"
    )
  else
    filters+=( "format=yuv420p" )
  fi

  # FPS
  [[ -n "$FPS" ]] && filters+=( "fps=${FPS}" )

  # Watermark image overlay
  if [[ -n "$WATERMARK_FILE" ]]; then
    local wm_abs="$REPO_ROOT/$WATERMARK_FILE"
    if [[ -f "$wm_abs" ]]; then
      # Overlay at bottom-right with 10px padding, 50% opacity
      filters+=( "[in]movie=${wm_abs},scale=iw/8:-1,format=rgba,colorchannelmixer=aa=0.5[wm];[in][wm]overlay=W-w-10:H-h-10[out]" )
    fi
  fi

  # Watermark text burn-in
  if [[ -n "$WATERMARK_TEXT" ]]; then
    local escaped_text="${WATERMARK_TEXT//:/\\:}"
    filters+=( "drawtext=text='${escaped_text}':fontcolor=white@0.5:fontsize=24:x=w-tw-10:y=h-th-10:shadowcolor=black@0.5:shadowx=2:shadowy=2" )
  fi

  # Join with comma
  local IFS=','
  echo "${filters[*]}"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build audio filter chain
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
build_af() {
  local filters=()
  # Loudnorm first pass is handled separately; this is used for 1-pass or final pass
  if $NORMALIZE_AUDIO; then
    # Use default EBU R128 targets: I=-23, TP=-2, LRA=7
    filters+=( "loudnorm=I=-23:TP=-2:LRA=7:print_format=summary" )
  fi
  local IFS=','
  echo "${filters[*]}"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build codec arguments
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
build_vcodec_args() {
  local args=()
  case "$CODEC" in
    h264)
      args+=( -c:v libx264 -preset "$PRESET" )
      if [[ -n "$CRF" ]]; then
        args+=( -crf "$CRF" )
      else
        args+=( -b:v "$BITRATE" )
      fi
      args+=( -profile:v high -level 4.1 )
      args+=( -movflags +faststart )
      ;;
    h265|hevc)
      args+=( -c:v libx265 -preset "$PRESET" )
      [[ -n "$CRF" ]] && args+=( -crf "$CRF" ) || args+=( -b:v "$BITRATE" )
      args+=( -tag:v hvc1 )
      ;;
    vp9)
      args+=( -c:v libvpx-vp9 -deadline best -cpu-used 0 )
      [[ -n "$CRF" ]] && args+=( -crf "$CRF" -b:v 0 ) || args+=( -b:v "$BITRATE" )
      args+=( -tile-columns 2 -tile-rows 2 -frame-parallel 0 -auto-alt-ref 1 -lag-in-frames 25 )
      ;;
    av1)
      args+=( -c:v libsvtav1 )
      local av1_preset="${PRESET:-4}"
      [[ "$av1_preset" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || av1_preset=4
      args+=( -preset "$av1_preset" )
      [[ -n "$CRF" ]] && args+=( -crf "$CRF" ) || args+=( -b:v "$BITRATE" )
      ;;
    copy)
      args+=( -c:v copy )
      ;;
    *)
      echo "[gen-video] WARNING: unknown codec '$CODEC', using h264" >&2
      args+=( -c:v libx264 -preset slow )
      [[ -n "$CRF" ]] && args+=( -crf "$CRF" ) || args+=( -b:v "$BITRATE" )
      ;;
  esac
  echo "${args[@]}"
}

build_acodec_args() {
  local args=()
  if $NO_AUDIO; then
    args+=( -an )
  elif $AUDIO_ONLY; then
    args+=( -vn )
    case "$AUDIO_CODEC" in
      aac)  args+=( -c:a aac -b:a "$AUDIO_BITRATE" -ar 48000 ) ;;
      opus) args+=( -c:a libopus -b:a "$AUDIO_BITRATE" -ar 48000 -application audio ) ;;
      mp3)  args+=( -c:a libmp3lame -b:a "$AUDIO_BITRATE" -q:a 2 ) ;;
      copy) args+=( -c:a copy ) ;;
      none) args+=( -an ) ;;
    esac
  else
    case "$AUDIO_CODEC" in
      aac)  args+=( -c:a aac -b:a "$AUDIO_BITRATE" -ar 48000 ) ;;
      opus) args+=( -c:a libopus -b:a "$AUDIO_BITRATE" -ar 48000 -application audio ) ;;
      mp3)  args+=( -c:a libmp3lame -b:a "$AUDIO_BITRATE" -q:a 2 ) ;;
      copy) args+=( -c:a copy ) ;;
      none) args+=( -an ) ;;
    esac
  fi
  echo "${args[@]}"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hardware acceleration input args
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
hwaccel_input_args() {
  case "$HWACCEL" in
    vaapi)        echo "-hwaccel vaapi -hwaccel_device /dev/dri/renderD128" ;;
    nvenc)        echo "-hwaccel cuda -hwaccel_output_format cuda" ;;
    videotoolbox) echo "-hwaccel videotoolbox" ;;
    *)            echo "" ;;
  esac
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EBU R128 two-pass audio normalisation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
normalize_audio_2pass() {
  local input="$1" output="$2"
  echo "[gen-video]   Audio normalisation pass 1/2 (measuring loudness)..."

  local stats
  stats="$(ffmpeg -y -i "$input" \
    -af "loudnorm=I=-23:TP=-2:LRA=7:print_format=json" \
    -f null /dev/null 2>&1 | \
    grep -A 20 'Parsed_loudnorm' | \
    grep -oP '"[a-z_]+":\s*"-?[0-9.]+"' || echo '{}')"

  # Extract measured values (fallback to defaults if extraction fails)
  local input_i;  input_i="$(echo  "$stats" | grep 'input_i'  | grep -oP '-?[0-9.]+' | head -1 || echo '-23')"
  local input_tp; input_tp="$(echo "$stats" | grep 'input_tp' | grep -oP '-?[0-9.]+' | head -1 || echo '-2')"
  local input_lra;input_lra="$(echo "$stats" | grep 'input_lra'| grep -oP '-?[0-9.]+' | head -1 || echo '7')"
  local input_thresh; input_thresh="$(echo "$stats" | grep 'input_thresh'| grep -oP '-?[0-9.]+' | head -1 || echo '-33')"
  local target_offset; target_offset="$(echo "$stats" | grep 'target_offset'| grep -oP '-?[0-9.]+' | head -1 || echo '0')"

  echo "[gen-video]   Audio normalisation pass 2/2 (applying correction)..."
  ffmpeg -y -i "$input" \
    -af "loudnorm=I=-23:TP=-2:LRA=7:measured_I=${input_i}:measured_TP=${input_tp}:measured_LRA=${input_lra}:measured_thresh=${input_thresh}:offset=${target_offset}:linear=true:print_format=summary" \
    -c:a aac -b:a "$AUDIO_BITRATE" \
    -vn "$output"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Thumbnail sprite sheet generation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
generate_thumbnail_sprite() {
  local video="$1"
  local sprite_out="${TARGET%.*}-sprite.jpg"
  local vtt_out="${TARGET%.*}-sprite.vtt"

  echo "[gen-video] Generating thumbnail sprite sheet (every ${THUMB_INTERVAL}s)..."

  # Extract frames
  local frames_dir="$WORKDIR/thumbs"
  mkdir -p "$frames_dir"

  ffmpeg -y -i "$video" \
    -vf "fps=1/${THUMB_INTERVAL},scale=160:90" \
    -q:v 5 \
    "$frames_dir/thumb_%05d.jpg" 2>/dev/null

  local frame_count
  frame_count="$(ls "$frames_dir"/thumb_*.jpg 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)"
  echo "[gen-video]   Extracted $frame_count thumbnail frames."

  if (( frame_count == 0 )); then
    echo "[gen-video] WARNING: no frames extracted for sprite." >&2
    return
  fi

  # Compose into a sprite grid (10 columns)
  local COLS=10
  local ROWS=$(( (frame_count + COLS - 1) / COLS ))

  if command -v convert &>/dev/null; then
    convert \
      +adjoin \
      "$frames_dir"/thumb_*.jpg \
      -geometry 160x90+0+0 \
      -tile "${COLS}x${ROWS}" \
      -background black \
      montage \
      "$frames_dir"/thumb_*.jpg \
      -tile "${COLS}x" \
      -geometry 160x90+0+0 \
      "$sprite_out" 2>/dev/null || {
        # Fallback: just montage linearly
        convert "$frames_dir"/thumb_*.jpg +append "$sprite_out" 2>/dev/null || true
      }
    echo "[gen-video]   Sprite sheet: $sprite_out"
  else
    echo "[gen-video] WARNING: ImageMagick not found; cannot compose sprite sheet." >&2
  fi

  # Generate WebVTT
  {
    echo "WEBVTT"
    echo ""
    local t=0
    local idx=1
    while (( idx <= frame_count )); do
      local col=$(( (idx - 1) % COLS ))
      local row=$(( (idx - 1) / COLS ))
      local x=$(( col * 160 ))
      local y=$(( row * 90 ))
      local t_end=$(( t + THUMB_INTERVAL ))

      printf '%02d:%02d:%02d.000 --> %02d:%02d:%02d.000\n' \
        "$(( t / 3600 ))" "$(( (t % 3600) / 60 ))" "$(( t % 60 ))" \
        "$(( t_end / 3600 ))" "$(( (t_end % 3600) / 60 ))" "$(( t_end % 60 ))"
      echo "$(basename "$sprite_out")#xywh=${x},${y},160,90"
      echo ""
      (( t += THUMB_INTERVAL )) || true
      (( idx++ )) || true
    done
  } > "$vtt_out"
  echo "[gen-video]   WebVTT track: $vtt_out"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main encode
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
VF="$(build_vf)"
AF="$(build_af)"

# shellcheck disable=SC2207
VCODEC_ARGS=( $(build_vcodec_args) )
# shellcheck disable=SC2207
ACODEC_ARGS=( $(build_acodec_args) )
# shellcheck disable=SC2207
HW_ARGS=( $(hwaccel_input_args) )

TRIM_ARGS=()
[[ -n "$TRIM_START" ]]    && TRIM_ARGS+=( -ss "$TRIM_START" )
[[ -n "$TRIM_DURATION" ]] && TRIM_ARGS+=( -t "$TRIM_DURATION" )

# -- Two-pass audio normalisation (produces a pre-normalised audio file) --
AUDIO_INPUT="$TEMPLATE"
if $NORMALIZE_AUDIO && ! $NO_AUDIO; then
  echo "[gen-video] Running EBU R128 two-pass audio normalisation..."
  NORM_AUDIO="$WORKDIR/normalized_audio.m4a"
  normalize_audio_2pass "$TEMPLATE" "$NORM_AUDIO"
  AUDIO_INPUT="$NORM_AUDIO"
fi

# -- Video encode --
if [[ "$CODEC" == "vp9" && -z "$CRF" && "$PASSES" -ge 2 ]]; then
  # VP9 two-pass is especially beneficial
  echo "[gen-video] Encode pass 1/2 (VP9 stats)..."
  ffmpeg -y "${HW_ARGS[@]}" \
    -i "$TEMPLATE" \
    "${TRIM_ARGS[@]}" \
    $( [[ -n "$VF" ]] && echo "-vf $VF" ) \
    "${VCODEC_ARGS[@]}" \
    -pass 1 -an \
    -f null /dev/null

  echo "[gen-video] Encode pass 2/2 (VP9 final)..."
  ffmpeg -y "${HW_ARGS[@]}" \
    -i "$TEMPLATE" \
    -i "$AUDIO_INPUT" \
    "${TRIM_ARGS[@]}" \
    $( [[ -n "$VF" ]] && echo "-vf $VF" ) \
    "${VCODEC_ARGS[@]}" \
    -pass 2 \
    "${ACODEC_ARGS[@]}" \
    -threads "$THREADS" \
    "$TARGET"

elif [[ "$PASSES" -ge 2 && -z "$CRF" && "$CODEC" =~ ^(h264|h265|hevc)$ ]]; then
  # Standard two-pass CBR/VBR
  echo "[gen-video] Encode pass 1/2 (stats gathering, preset=${PRESET})..."
  ffmpeg -y "${HW_ARGS[@]}" \
    -i "$TEMPLATE" \
    "${TRIM_ARGS[@]}" \
    $( [[ -n "$VF" ]] && echo "-vf $VF" ) \
    "${VCODEC_ARGS[@]}" \
    -pass 1 -an \
    -f null /dev/null

  echo "[gen-video] Encode pass 2/2 (final encode, preset=${PRESET})..."
  ffmpeg -y "${HW_ARGS[@]}" \
    -i "$TEMPLATE" \
    -i "$AUDIO_INPUT" \
    "${TRIM_ARGS[@]}" \
    $( [[ -n "$VF" ]] && echo "-vf $VF" ) \
    "${VCODEC_ARGS[@]}" \
    -pass 2 \
    "${ACODEC_ARGS[@]}" \
    -threads "$THREADS" \
    "$TARGET"

else
  # Single-pass (CRF, av1, copy, audio-only)
  echo "[gen-video] Single-pass encode..."
  local_inputs=( -i "$TEMPLATE" )
  [[ "$AUDIO_INPUT" != "$TEMPLATE" ]] && local_inputs+=( -i "$AUDIO_INPUT" )

  ffmpeg -y "${HW_ARGS[@]}" \
    "${local_inputs[@]}" \
    "${TRIM_ARGS[@]}" \
    $( [[ -n "$VF" ]] && echo "-vf $VF" ) \
    $( [[ -n "$AF" && ! "$NO_AUDIO" == "true" ]] && echo "-af $AF" ) \
    "${VCODEC_ARGS[@]}" \
    "${ACODEC_ARGS[@]}" \
    -threads "$THREADS" \
    "$TARGET"
fi

# -- Thumbnail sprite sheet (optional, post-encode) --
$THUMBNAIL && generate_thumbnail_sprite "$TARGET"

# -- Report --
SRC_SIZE="$(stat -c%s "$TEMPLATE" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$TEMPLATE" 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
OUT_SIZE="$(stat -c%s "$TARGET"   2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$TARGET"   2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
echo "[gen-video] Done: $TARGET"
echo "[gen-video]   Source size : $(numfmt --to=iec "$SRC_SIZE" 2>/dev/null || echo "${SRC_SIZE}B")"
echo "[gen-video]   Output size : $(numfmt --to=iec "$OUT_SIZE" 2>/dev/null || echo "${OUT_SIZE}B")"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# gen-resize.sh — resource-intensive multi-resolution image derive generator
#
# Delegates to gen-image.sh with --mode=fill and a size inferred from the
# target filename. Supports all gen-image.sh options as pass-through args.
#
# Called by asset-rebuild as:
#   gen-resize.sh <template_path> <target_path> [OPTIONS]
#
# Extra OPTIONS (in addition to all gen-image.sh options)
#   --retina            Also generate a 2x retina variant (@2x suffix)
#   --strip-metadata    Alias for --strip-exif (default: on)
#
# Examples
#   tile-512.png    → 512x512   (square, inferred from name)
#   hero-1920x1080  → 1920x1080 (WxH, inferred from name)
#   banner.png      → native dimensions (no change, still runs full pipeline)

set -euo pipefail

TEMPLATE="$1"
TARGET="$2"
shift 2

RETINA=false
PASSTHROUGH_ARGS=()

for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --retina)          RETINA=true ;;
    --strip-metadata)  PASSTHROUGH_ARGS+=( "--strip-exif" ) ;;
    *)                 PASSTHROUGH_ARGS+=( "$arg" ) ;;
  esac
done

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
GEN_IMAGE="$SCRIPT_DIR/gen-image.sh"

if [[ ! -x "$GEN_IMAGE" ]]; then
  echo "[gen-resize] ERROR: gen-image.sh not found at $GEN_IMAGE" >&2
  exit 2
fi

# Infer dimensions from target filename
BASENAME="$(basename "$TARGET" | sed 's/\.[^.]*$//')"
SIZE_ARGS=()

if [[ "$BASENAME" =~ ([0-9]+)x([0-9]+) ]]; then
  W="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"; H="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
  SIZE_ARGS+=( "--width=${W}" "--height=${H}" )
  echo "[gen-resize] Inferred size: ${W}x${H} from filename"
elif [[ "$BASENAME" =~ ([0-9]+)$ ]]; then
  DIM="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
  SIZE_ARGS+=( "--width=${DIM}" "--height=${DIM}" )
  echo "[gen-resize] Inferred size: ${DIM}x${DIM} from filename"
else
  echo "[gen-resize] No size in filename — preserving source dimensions"
fi

echo "[gen-resize] Delegating to gen-image.sh..."
"$GEN_IMAGE" "$TEMPLATE" "$TARGET" \
  --mode=fill \
  --passes=2 \
  --progressive \
  "${SIZE_ARGS[@]}" \
  "${PASSTHROUGH_ARGS[@]}"

# Optional retina variant
if $RETINA; then
  EXT="${TARGET##*.}"
  BASE="${TARGET%.*}"
  RETINA_TARGET="${BASE}@2x.${EXT}"

  if [[ "$BASENAME" =~ ([0-9]+)x([0-9]+) ]]; then
    RW=$(( BASH_REMATCH[1] * 2 )); RH=$(( BASH_REMATCH[2] * 2 ))
    RETINA_SIZE_ARGS=( "--width=${RW}" "--height=${RH}" )
  elif [[ "$BASENAME" =~ ([0-9]+)$ ]]; then
    RD=$(( BASH_REMATCH[1] * 2 ))
    RETINA_SIZE_ARGS=( "--width=${RD}" "--height=${RD}" )
  else
    RETINA_SIZE_ARGS=()
  fi

  echo "[gen-resize] Generating retina variant: $RETINA_TARGET"
  "$GEN_IMAGE" "$TEMPLATE" "$RETINA_TARGET" \
    --mode=fill \
    --passes=2 \
    --progressive \
    "${RETINA_SIZE_ARGS[@]}" \
    "${PASSTHROUGH_ARGS[@]}"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PHASE 2 — Recreate assets from source templates
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
phase_recreate() {
  [[ ! -f "$MANIFEST_FILE" ]] && {
    warn "No manifest found at '$MANIFEST_FILE' — skipping recreation phase."
    warn "Create $MANIFEST_FILE to define templates. See --help for the format."
    return 0
  }

  require_jq

  local entry_count; entry_count="$(jq 'length' "$MANIFEST_FILE")"
  info "Phase 2: recreating assets from $entry_count template entry/entries in $MANIFEST_FILE..."

  local created=0
  local failed=0

  for i in $(seq 0 $(( entry_count - 1 ))); do
    local template target_json generator generator_args_json

    template="$(jq -r ".[$i].template" "$MANIFEST_FILE")"
    target_json="$(jq -c ".[$i].targets" "$MANIFEST_FILE")"
    generator="$(jq -r ".[$i].generator // empty" "$MANIFEST_FILE")"
    generator_args_json="$(jq -c ".[$i].generator_args // []" "$MANIFEST_FILE")"

    local template_path="$TEMPLATE_DIR/$template"

    if [[ ! -f "$template_path" ]]; then
      error "Template not found: $template_path  (entry $i)"
      (( failed++ )) || true
      continue
    fi

    # Read targets into an array
    local targets=()
    while IFS= read -r t; do
      targets+=("$t")
    done < <(echo "$target_json" | jq -r '.[]')

    # Read generator_args into an array
    local generator_args=()
    while IFS= read -r a; do
      generator_args+=("$a")
    done < <(echo "$generator_args_json" | jq -r '.[]')

    for target in "${targets[@]}"; do
      local target_path="$REPO_ROOT/$target"
      local target_dir; target_dir="$(dirname "$target_path")"
      local rel_target; rel_target="$(realpath --relative-to="$REPO_ROOT" "$target_path" 2>/dev/null || echo "$target")"

      if $DRY_RUN; then
        if [[ -n "$generator" ]]; then
          verbose "GENERATE  $rel_target  via $generator"
        else
          verbose "COPY      $rel_target  ← $template"
        fi
        (( created++ )) || true
        continue
      fi

      # Ensure parent directory exists
      mkdir -p "$target_dir"

      if [[ -n "$generator" ]]; then
        # Run the custom generator
        local gen_path="$REPO_ROOT/$generator"
        if [[ ! -x "$gen_path" ]]; then
          error "Generator not found or not executable: $gen_path  (entry $i)"
          (( failed++ )) || true
          continue
        fi

        verbose "GENERATE  $rel_target  via $generator"
        if ! "$gen_path" "$template_path" "$target_path" "${generator_args[@]}" 2>&1; then
          error "Generator failed for: $rel_target"
          (( failed++ )) || true
          continue
        fi
      else
        # Default: plain copy, preserving timestamps
        verbose "COPY      $rel_target  ← $template"
        cp -p "$template_path" "$target_path"
      fi

      (( created++ )) || true
    done

  else
    if (( failed > 0 )); then
      warn "  Recreated $created file(s) with $failed error(s)."
    else
      success "  Recreated $created file(s) successfully."
    fi
  fi

  return $(( failed > 0 ? 3 : 0 ))
}
